open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Arborist & Tree Climbing Professionals
proposals.buyer_persona: Professional arborists and tree climbers who take immense pride in high-altitude danger, technical rigging, and chainsaw precision. They love decorating their gear (helmets, water bottles, trucks) with insider jargon and technical knot graphics.
product_angles: Highly technical SVG vector bundles of rigging knots and chainsaw silhouettes for local B2B branding
Arborist helmet stickers (Redbubble) using insider humor like 'Rigging Physics' or 'Spur Climber'
Daily climbing safety & tree health inspection logbooks (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: Arborist Helmet Decals & Vector Bundle (Knot diagrams & humor)

proposals.name: PSX Retro-Style Low-Poly 3D Assets for Indie Devs
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo indie game developers building retro-horror or 90s-nostalgia games on Godot or Unity who need optimized, low-poly OBJ/FBX models with pixelated textures.
product_angles: Retro PS1-style low-poly props pack (street lamps, trash cans, old TVs) on Cults3D/Itch.io
Pixel-art UI button sets and icon packs
proposals.first_test_product: 90s Retro Mall / Corridor Low-Poly Asset Pack (FBX + textures)

proposals.name: Solo Board Gaming (1-Player Tabletop)
proposals.buyer_persona: Adults who play heavy board games alone. They are highly organized, appreciate tactile components, and love tracking their campaigns, high scores, and house rules.
product_angles: Solo campaign tracker notebooks and scorecards (KDP)
Print-and-Play (PnP) minimalistic solo card game templates
proposals.first_test_product: The Ultimate Solo Board Gamer Campaign Logbook

proposals.name: Vintage Tech Restoration & Retro-Computing
proposals.buyer_persona: Hobbyists restoring 80s/90s computers (Amiga, Commodore, early Macintosh, IBM PCs). They need precise physical dimensions, custom brackets, replacement badges, and templates.
product_angles: 3D printable mounting brackets (e.g., SD card reader to floppy drive bay converters) on Cults3D
Vector recreation of vintage motherboard layouts and patent-style art prints (Redbubble)
Restoration logbook to track capacitor replacements, voltage checks, and serial numbers (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: 3.5-inch Floppy Bay to modern SD-Card Reader 3D Printable Mount

proposals.name: Sourdough & Micro-Baking Obsessives
proposals.buyer_persona: Home bakers obsessed with hydration ratios, starter feeding schedules, and bread scoring art. They view baking as a science and a lifestyle.
product_angles: Flour hydration cheat-sheet magnets and stickers for kitchen appliances (Redbubble)
A highly detailed 'Bread Scoring Template & Pattern Book' (KDP)
Sourdough Starter feeding diary and hydration percentage logs

proposals.name: Local Amateur Astronomy Clubs
proposals.buyer_persona: Organizers of small astronomy associations and individual astrophotography geeks. They need customized tools, logbooks, and simple 3D utility parts.
product_angles: Night sky observation logs with technical exposure-time tracking tables (KDP)
3D printable custom Bahtinov focus masks for specific camera lens sizes (Cults3D)
Constellation vector design packs for club merch custom printing (B2B/SVG)
